meta.name: pathfinder
meta.description: Map a codebase into feature-grouped flowcharts, identify duplicated concerns across features, and propose a unified architecture. Use when asked to "find the ideal path," unify duplicated systems, or audit architecture before a refactor. Emits a proposed unified flowchart plus per-system /make-plan prompts.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将代码库映射为功能流程图，识别重复并统一架构
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在重构或统一多个重复系统
copy.tagline_en: Map codebase into feature flowcharts, identify duplicates, and unify architecture
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are refactoring or unifying duplicated systems

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会把你的代码库按功能分组画成流程图,找出不同功能里重复的部分,提出一个统一的架构方案,并生成一份你可以直接拿去用的改造计划。它只出方案和图表,不直接改代码。
howto.when: 当你让它“找到理想路径”、要求统一重复的系统,或在重构前审查架构时,它会接管并启动这套分析流程。

say.text: 帮我把这个代码库按功能画成流程图,标出入口和依赖
找出各个功能里重复实现的共同逻辑,给出合并建议
say.note: 它会产出带文件行号证据的重复报告。

say.text: 统一这两个重复系统,生成 /make-plan 交接提示
say.note: 它会输出包含具体改点的新架构方案和计划提示。

howto.what_en: Claude maps your codebase into feature-grouped flowcharts, spots duplicated concerns, and proposes a unified architecture. It outputs diagrams, a duplication report, a unified flowchart, and /make-plan handoff prompts. It does not write code.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to "find the ideal path," unify duplicated systems, or audit architecture before a refactor. It then runs the full mapping and proposal workflow.

say_en.text: Map this codebase into feature flowcharts with entry points and dependencies.
Find repeated logic across features and suggest consolidations.
say_en.note: Produces a duplication report with file:line evidence.

say_en.text: Unify these two systems and generate /make-plan handoff prompts.
say_en.note: Writes a unified proposal and copy-pasteable plan prompts.
